wholePhysicalScope: The 47-corner named OpenStreetMap way supplies the exterior perimeter. Its bowed front and square-facing end fix the model axis. Exact source coordinates accompany the footprint.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the double-oval nave and chancel, rounded towers and stepped three-arch front. Near levels refine the moldings, balustrades, bells and entrance grilles.
limitations: The footprint fixes the double-oval plan, rear volume and tower projections. Exact roof and bell-tower heights, the profiles of the curved front and details of the attachment are estimates.
The municipal sources identify the materials and principal architectural forms. Finish colors, roof tile layout, the relief shapes, opening details and staircase dimensions are simplified estimates.
The church comprises the modeled asset. Nearby dwellings, the fountain and the other Rosário church in Ouro Preto are separate landmarks.
The entrance level is placed slightly above the original elevation samples across the three openings. The outer steps meet the sloping terrain at different heights.
